correctness.rationale: Read the actual printed complete F, Segre maps and factors f11 f13 f21 f23. Independent sparse polynomial multiplication verified Q_i(phi_i)=0, F(phi_1)=-f11 f13 and F(phi_2)=-3f21 f23 exactly over Z, and det of both Segre transformations is 3. Bidegrees are (1,3),(3,1), so rational quartic components follow from cited Roulleau irreducibility. Roulleau Example 26 and Prop 24 give geometric Picard 3 and full S2 lattice; H and two components have determinant 108, so they generate NS. Galois fixes these classes; for any other (-2)-curve B, a distinct conjugate in same class would intersect B in -2, impossible for distinct effective irreducible curves. Unique containing quadric gives Q-descent of the third. No claim about Q-rational points.
